# docker_config (Data Source)

Looks up one swarm config (`GET /configs/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. `inspect.spec.data` is the content, base64-encoded as the Engine returns it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_config" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx-default.conf"
}

output "nginx_conf" {
  value = base64decode(data.docker_config.nginx.inspect.spec.data)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The config ID or a unique ID prefix; resolved to the full ID. Conflicts with `name`.
- `name` (String) The config name. Conflicts with `id`.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of inspect_json; changes whenever the object changes.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon the provider talked to (GET /version Version).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version the provider negotiated with the daemon (GET /version ApiVersion, capped by the client's max).
- `inspect` (Attributes) The config inspect response as a nested object mirroring Config field by field (snake_case). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inspect))
- `inspect_json` (String) The exact Engine API inspect response for the config, as JSON.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the config (`Spec.Labels`).
- `version_index` (Number) The config object's `Version.Index`; it changes on every update.
